name: Can a dry P-trap cause drain odors?

mainEntity.name: Can a dry P-trap cause drain odors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a dry P-trap is a common cause of drain odors. The P-trap, the U-shaped pipe under sinks and other drains, is designed to hold a small amount of water. This water acts as a barrier, preventing sewer gases from rising up through the drain and into your home. If the P-trap dries out due to infrequent use, evaporation, or a leak, it loses its seal, allowing foul-smelling gases to escape. Simply running water down the drain usually refills the trap and solves the problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a dry P-trap allows sewer gases to enter your home because the water seal, which blocks odors, is gone.
